name: Lieutenant's Insignia
summary: Near Orgrimmar, cultists bear Lieutenant's Insignia and the Burning Blade's mark. Horde adventurers recover it from them.

sections.title: A Mark of the Cult
sections.body: Cultists at Skull Rock on Durotar's eastern shore carry Lieutenant's Insignia. The mark names its bearer an officer of the Burning Blade. Warchief Thrall will not suffer traitors in his new nation. Yet a purge might scatter the cult before its masters are exposed. So he entrusts the badge to a champion, to test those suspected of infiltrating beneath Orgrimmar.

sections.title: The Cleft of Shadow
sections.body: Warchief Thrall sends his agent to the Cleft of Shadow with Lieutenant's Insignia, to show it to Neeru Fireblade. Neeru mistakes the agent for a newly promoted subordinate. Sure of his standing, the warlock boasts that the Burning Blade serves the Shadow Council and the Burning Legion. Those words give Thrall a way to expose the corruption beneath the city.

faq.q: Where does the Lieutenant's Insignia come from?
aliases: how do i get lieutenants insignia
faq.answer: Burning Blade fanatics and apprentices in Skull Rock carry Lieutenant's Insignia. The cavern lies on Durotar's coast east of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: What is the insignia used for?
aliases: why do i need lieutenants insignia
faq.answer: Warchief Thrall gives Lieutenant's Insignia to his agent as a disguise. A young adventurer bearing it can pass as a Burning Blade officer and reach places Thrall's agents cannot, to learn who leads the cult.
Neeru Fireblade is an orc warlock in Orgrimmar's Cleft of Shadow. He claims to serve Thrall by showing how warlocks can aid the Horde, but secretly leads the local Burning Blade cult.

faq.q: Why doesn't Thrall just kill Neeru Fireblade immediately?
faq.answer: Thrall knows Neeru is a traitor, but an early strike could warn the cult's true masters and scatter its network. He uses Neeru as an unwitting informant to uncover the Shadow Council's wider presence in Durotar.

angles.text: For the young Horde, Lieutenant's Insignia marks the danger of demonic corruption trying to undermine Thrall's new nation from within.
For a warlock, Lieutenant's Insignia shows the Burning Blade turning fel magic to the Burning Legion's service. That strains Thrall's tolerance of lawful Horde warlocks.
